Getting started
Enable Privacy Display+ in LSPosed and select System Framework and System UI. Return here and tap Soft reboot.

Choose your apps
Open Settings → Display → Privacy display → Conditions for turning on → Apps. Turn on conditions and choose the apps you want to protect.

Window protection
Floating windows and Split screen work independently. Changes apply immediately while the app shows Active. Turning either switch off restores Samsung defaults for that window type. Full-screen apps and other Samsung privacy conditions keep their usual behavior.

System panels
Choose Off, On, or Maximum independently for Notification Center and Quick Settings. Each option affects only its own open panel. Maximum also requests the shared screen level and may dim the rest of the display.

App rules
Choose Default, Window only or Full screen separately for each window type. Default follows the switches on the home screen. Enable Maximum privacy protection in an app rule to request the shared Maximum level while that app is protected. Other protected windows share this level.

Popup handle
Open a floating window’s handle menu and tap the phone-and-shield button. The choice lasts for that floating session. Other Samsung conditions can still protect the whole screen.

Soft reboot
Save your work first: running apps will close. This uses the supported KernelSU userspace reload command, with no full-reboot fallback. Grant root access when asked. Temporary root may need to be re-established after a device reboot.

Compatibility
Support is limited to the firmware listed in the project’s support guide. Recents cards and Picture-in-Picture are not included.
